units.actions: unnormalized policy action units, before environment scaling/clipping
units.contact_forces: MuJoCo solver estimate in contact frame

notes: no extra ACT predictions; full chunks captured from original forwards
gripper target is not finger position or grip force
contact flags are constraint-active contacts, not binary grasp success
cube/contact measurements are diagnostic only, never policy inputs
the traced run has logging overhead; simulation stepping is unchanged

definitions.preclose_chunks: predictions made before the first executed close command
definitions.target_residual: per-step target delta minus 0.025 * raw XYZ action; Z clipping can make this nonzero

limitations: Trace validation does not make process exit successful.
Raw policy actions and mocap target changes are distinct from measured TCP motion.
Tail predictions are discarded; their execution and task outcome remain untested.
Changing the prefix also changes approach trajectories; it is not a same-state causal intervention.
